company.description: Pretty Instant is the leading platform for professional photography services. Covering the entire spectrum of corporate and private photography services in all 50 States, the company hand-selects the best photographers in each market who are professionals and pass federal & state background checks. Pretty Instant handles all of the communication, staffing, editing, invoicing, and hosting of images; providing clients with a streamlined and enjoyable experience for capturing all of their life's work and experiences.
